title: Therapeutic Effects of "Ibuprofen, Diphenhydramine and Aluminium MgS" on Recurrent Aphthous Stomatitis
brief_summary: The intention of the study is to study the effects of Ibuprofen, Diphenhydramine and Aluminium MgS in decreasing the signs of recurrent aphthous stomatitis (RAS)
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* possessing at least one painful aphthous ulcer in the last 3 days
* older than 10 years of age

Exclusion Criteria:

* systemic disease or specific syndrome (such as Behcet's)
* pregnancy
* breastfeeding
* allergy to NSAIDs
* history of asthma, peptic ulcers, hepatic and renal failures and hemorrhagic disorders
* consumption of anti-inflammatory medications in the last 24 hours
